dissent: The change set satisfies every acceptance criterion as written and still does not deliver what the task asked for: the criteria describe a counter that never double-counts, and the implementation reaches that by not counting at all in the one path the operator cares about. A reader of the criteria would call this done; a reader of the problem statement would not.

findings.issue: Criteria satisfied, requested outcome not delivered
findings.evidence: problem_statement names the rewind path explicitly; the shipped counter skips it, and the criterion that would have caught it was written narrowly enough to pass anyway.
